list.emptyBody: Your orders will be here: those you make for a customer, and those your stores send, with what each has shipped.

customers.label: Customer
customers.noContacts: Your community has no contacts yet. Type a customer's name to add them, or add your customers to the community's contacts in Initiative.
customers.loadFailed: The community's contacts couldn't be read.
customers.required: Choose the customer the order is for.

order.title: Order {{code}}
order.codeHint: Leave it empty for the next number.
order.deleteBody: The order and its shipments go. Nothing of it has shipped, so no stock moves.

lines.priceHint: Leave it empty for the item's own price.
lines.empty: Nothing is on this order yet.

shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.nothingPicked: Type how much of something the shipment sends.
shipments.addressHint: The order's address when left empty.
shipments.shipBody: Each line leaves the lot it names, or the one that expires first.
shipments.damagedHint: It is written off as returned damaged, not put back into stock.
shipments.restockHint: It goes back into the lot it left.

errors.ORDER_ITEM_NOT_SOLD: Only a product's variation can be sold.
errors.ORDER_CANCELLED: The order is cancelled. Reopen it to change it.
errors.ORDER_FROM_STORE: This order came from a store: its items change in the store.
errors.ORDER_LINE_PART: This is part of a bundle: change the bundle instead.
errors.ORDER_LINE_SHIPPED: A shipment holds this line. Change the shipment first.
errors.ORDER_SHIPPED: Something of this order has shipped, so it is kept.
errors.SHIPMENT_SHIPPED: The shipment has shipped. Take back shipping to change it.
errors.SHIPMENT_RETURNED: Something came back of this shipment, so it stays shipped.
errors.SHIPMENT_LINE_NOT_SHIPPABLE: That line doesn't ship itself: a bundle ships as its parts.
errors.SHIPMENT_OVER_ORDER: That is more than the order has left to ship.
errors.SHIPMENT_LOT_MISMATCH: That lot isn't this item's, at this shipment's location.
errors.RETURN_OVER_SHIPPED: That is more than the shipment sent of it.
